agents.name: The Operator
agents.description: Builds tools, converts strong odds, and disrupts a rival at match point.

agents.name: Lock Rusher
agents.description: Picks relentlessly and accepts weak odds for maximum race pressure.

agents.name: Tool Hoarder
agents.description: Builds a three-tool stack before converting it into high-probability picks.

agents.name: Leader Hunter
agents.description: Targets breakaways, then searches or picks when the race is compressed.

agents.name: Saboteur
agents.description: Steals useful tools and applies stuns, but pivots to picks to close games.
